WHAT LEDGERLY DOES

Less sorting. More certainty.

Spend arrives from every direction. Ledgerly gives every transaction one clear place to land — and tells you where to look.

01
Auto-categorisation

Every transaction lands in the right category the moment it clears. Your team reviews exceptions, not every line.

02
Duplicate detection

Ledgerly checks each charge against the ones around it, catching double payments and subscriptions that should have ended. Every match arrives with the evidence attached.

03
Month-end close

Work the close from one shared checklist instead of a chain of spreadsheets. When the last exception clears, your export is ready.

HOW IT WORKS

From swipe to close.

Three steps between a transaction and a clean ledger.

01
Connect your cards

Link company cards with read-only access. Ledgerly starts importing your transactions straight away.

02
Review flagged spend

Duplicates and outliers arrive in a single queue, with the context you need to make the call.

03
Export to your ledger

Send categorised entries to the accounting system your team already uses.

READY WHEN YOU ARE

before the deadline.

Bring the cards, the chart of accounts, and the deadline. Leave the sorting to Ledgerly.
